title: Hash-compressed task adapter bank on digit features
input_data: sklearn load_digits 1.8.0 normalized 8x8 pixel vectors; stratified split by world seed
task_construction: Eight task-specific continuous adapter targets y_t=x@A_t@B_t where A_t(64x2), B_t(2x16) are independently generated per world from frozen Gaussian seeds. The input examples are real digit images; targets are synthetic independent low-rank task functions. No natural-task or language claim.
hypothesis: A single 512-value hash table plus task-specific 32-angle Givens codes can represent eight useful task adapters at lower actual payload than independent hash/LoRA banks while reaching normalized held-out MSE <=0.10 and staying within +0.02 held-out RMSE of independent rank-2 LoRA.
physical_object: Shared 512-bucket adapter parameter vector (or per-task tables in independent controls); all targets are task-specific adapter matrices 64x16.
mirror_coordinate: One 32-angle adjacent-pair input rotation per task before the same shared hash-expanded 64x16 adapter matrix.
controls: independent per-task hash tables (512 buckets each)
shared hash table with task-specific deterministic hash salts
shared hash table plus task-specific Givens views
VeRA-style shared random rank-2 A/B basis plus learned per-task scaling vectors
generic shared task-matrix basis rank-8 with learned per-task coefficients

training.loss: mean squared error over batch, all 8 tasks and 16 outputs
training.initialization: deterministic per world/method; Givens identity; VeRA bases frozen random seed paid in payload metadata and actual bases serialized; shared basis learned

development.selection: No hyperparameter search. Rank, buckets, updates, optimizer and gates fixed before running.

fresh.open_rule: Run only if all three development worlds meet the complete quality/storage/native-control gate.

storage.authority: actual serialized inference NPZ bytes after reload and evaluation
storage.deterministic_reconstruction: Hash maps regenerated from charged uint32 seeds and frozen algorithm; all learned codes and bases serialized in FP16.

primary_metrics: held-out normalized MSE and RMSE by task and aggregate
success_gate: Across all three dev worlds: Mirror aggregate normalized MSE <=0.10; aggregate RMSE <= independent rank-2 LoRA RMSE +0.02; Mirror payload <=0.75x independent per-task 512-bucket hash bank; Mirror RMSE must beat shared salted hash and VeRA control by >=0.01; no per-task NRMSE >0.20.
failure_gate: Any dev quality, storage, per-task, or native-control gate miss is FAIL; fresh remains sealed.
boundaries: Synthetic independent task operators on real digit inputs; mechanism screen only
The number of tasks is not independent capacity
No natural pretrained-backbone or real PEFT task claim
Fixed-budget learning efficiency is not near-convergence capacity
